name: Zhouornis
sum: Pigeon-sized bohaiornithid from the Aptian Jehol Group of western Liaoning.
holotype: A skeleton from the Jiufotang Formation (number in Zhang et al. 2013).
material: Known from the holotype and a referred specimen in PBDB.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Zhang et al. 2013
